process_steps: Phase 1 (Dry Pre-Blending): High-speed pre-blend of dry ingredients (creamy salad dressing, Coconut Sugar) for 5 mins at 120 RPM.
Phase 2 (Liquid Emulsification & Additives): Incorporate lipid phase with functional emulsifiers (beer beverage) and minor preservation/acid components under high shear (2000 RPM).
Phase 3 (Compounding & Flavor Addition): Blend liquid and dry pre-mixes with sensory components (Natural Flavors) under vacuum to prevent air entrainment.
Phase 4 (Forming, Extrusion & Setting): Shape matrix into standard units; barrel temperature 35C-40C with controlled cooling tunnel (12C for 15 mins).
Phase 5 (Packaging & Modified Atmosphere): Nitrogen flush flow-wrap packaging to maintain low water activity (Aw < 0.65).
